public_payload.normalized_proposition: Sora will only become somewhat useful if OpenAI dramatically improves prompt precision, nearly eliminates hallucinations and vastly increases processing power.
conditions: for Sora to become kind of useful

statement.excerpt: To make Sora kind of useful, OpenAI will have to find a way to dramatically increase the precision of prompts, reduce hallucinations to almost nothing, and vastly increase processing power across the board.

from_speaker: To make Sora kind of useful
dramatically increase the precision of prompts

our_interpretation: The filmmaking context makes useful mean a practical contribution to a completed film, music video or advertisement.
The statement makes all three improvements necessary prerequisites. A useful deployment without any one prerequisite would refute it.
A released production establishes some practical usefulness, but does not by itself establish what model or infrastructure improvements were necessary.
No numerical improvement thresholds or deadline are supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Deployment records and comparable measurements establish that useful filmmaking required all three stated improvements.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented useful filmmaking deployment demonstrably operated without at least one of the asserted prerequisites.

evidence.explanation: The announced brand film establishes practical filmmaking use under the stated reading. The release describes iterative generation and corrective visual effects, but supplies no matched measurements of the three prerequisites.

OpenAI acknowledged substantial limitations when releasing Sora Turbo. This challenges the idea that public availability required eliminating errors, but does not measure errors in the particular useful deployment or establish its infrastructure requirements.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Production records paired with comparable error, prompt-compliance and compute measurements could establish a useful deployment without one prerequisite, or demonstrate that all three were necessary.
